Part Number: SA750R-8GOC


                                                      SPARKLE Intel® Arc™ A750 ROC OC Edition, 8GB GDDR6, 2x DBB 100mm Fan,
                                                      2.5-Slot, Metal Backplate, SA750R-8GOC
                                                      The SPARKLE Intel Arc A750 ROC OC Edition is the brand-new BEST choice of the A750 series, which
                                                      provides high performance and myriad of productivity without any thing getting in the way.
                                                      ROC series equipped dual 100mm double-ball bearing fan with 2.5-slot heatsink design, reduce the
                                                      length of card effetely and ready to fit into the compact system. Furthermore, 100mm DBB fans have
                                                      brought the higher efficiency of cooling, lead to an ultra-silence experience without compromising
                                                      performance.
